sloka: शरण्यः सर्व भूतानाम् पितुः निर्देश पारगः ।ज्येष्टो दशरथस्य अयम् पुत्राणाम् गुणवत्तरः ॥४-४-९॥
transliteration: śaraṇyaḥ sarva bhūtānām pituḥ nirdeśa pāragaḥ ।jyeṣṭo daśarathasya ayam putrāṇām guṇavattaraḥ ॥4-4-9॥

translations.english: This warrior, the most virtuous among Dasaratha's sons, endowed with royal marks and royal fortune, has been driven from the kingdom and has come here with me to dwell in the forest.
